_legacy_comment: Fast-path resolution for common bottlenecks. Used as a baseline for 'direct foundings' before falling back to pgvector semantic search.

basic_costing.primary_bottleneck: Inability to track basic job or product costs

basic_purchasing.primary_bottleneck: Manual procurement and untracked supplier orders

factory_wip_bridge.primary_bottleneck: Zero visibility into Work-In-Progress, factory treated as a black box

excel_bom_disconnect.primary_bottleneck: Production schedules and formulations managed in disconnected Excel sheets
